project.name: The Palm Unity
project.tagline: Rising Above Kudasan, Rooted in Zen Living
project.about: The Palm Unity is a Zen Living address by The Palm Group in Kudasan, Gandhinagar — spacious 3 and 4 BHK homes crafted for an exclusive community, with sky bridges linking the towers, a resort-style pool deck and The Sky Hall on the 20th floor.

highlights: Spacious 3 & 4 BHK homes from 314 to 463 sq.yds super built-up
Sky bridges connecting every tower, above a resort-style pool deck
Cantilevered balconies that project beyond the facade for open views
3 basement levels of parking — the ground floor stays for people
Covered porte-cochère with pick-up & drop-off zone and valet parking
The Sky Hall — a banquet hall on the 20th floor
